notes:
Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.26.1:

- Default data now seeds automatically on every fresh install. The curated knowledge base — rule-engine templates, version EoL/EoM data, the endpoint support matrix, destination patterns, report windows and DLP posture sections — loads on first launch with no manual backup restore needed.
- A fresh install imports the full seed; on later launches, only the reference/catalogue data is refreshed when the shipped seed changes — in-progress sessions, answers, certificates and customer data are never touched.
- Seeding runs silently before the app renders and falls back to built-in defaults if offline, so it never blocks startup. A small one-off confirmation appears when default data is applied.
- Admins can refresh the shipped defaults by exporting a System Backup, running `npm run seed`, and redeploying — secrets (auth token, credentials) are stripped automatically from the committed seed.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
